name: codex-manual-v1
purpose: Record comparable Codex work in Smaller Talk and the Codex desktop app, including execution backends.
execution: manual; markers do not submit prompts or verify completion

required_operator_record.model: RECORD THE SAME EXACT MODEL IN BOTH APPS
required_operator_record.reasoning_effort: RECORD THE SAME EFFORT IN BOTH APPS
required_operator_record.provider_version: RECORD THE CLI OR BUNDLED APP-SERVER VERSION FOR EACH APP
required_operator_record.workspace: USE THE SAME SYNTHETIC EMPTY WORKSPACE
required_operator_record.window: RECORD LOGICAL SIZE, DISPLAY SCALE, AND VISIBLE PANELS
required_operator_record.configuration: RECORD INSTRUCTIONS, SKILLS, TOOLS, REWRITING, AND OTHER ACTIVE WORK

starting_state: Fresh conversation in each app; no attachments or prior messages. A fresh conversation does not reset app caches.

phases.action: Keep the prepared conversation visible for 30 seconds.
Submit the original v3 prompt using Codex. Keep the conversation visible until completion. Record any failure or mismatch.
After the final response is visible and Working ends, leave the app idle for 30 seconds.
Finish measurement; record numbered paragraph count, output bytes, visible completion, and backend scope.

limits: Real model output and chunk timing are nondeterministic; identical prompts do not establish equal output or work.
Fill configuration placeholders in a copied manifest before a controlled comparison; keep the same copy for both captures.
Busy-system captures validate the framework and carry no performance verdict.
This workload does not replace deterministic fixture tests, history rendering tests, or retention tests.
